newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Britain's Princess Anne to visit Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Princess Anne to visit Hong Kong.

text.p: Britain's Princess Anne will arrive in Hong Kong on Tuesday evening for a four-day visit, five months before the British colony reverts to China, the government said on Monday.
She will officiate on Thursday at the opening of the new British Consulate building, which will come into use after Britain returns the territory to China on July 1.
Her itinerary includes a visit to the territory's new Chek Lap Kok airport, which is expected to be completed by April 1998.
